installation.generationRule: Publish the compiled staged package under publicationName at version. Workspace source remains private. Registry examples use the user-selected name; publication status is established by npm receipts.

sideEffects.stagingRule: Stage audited false. Authored initialization only allocates module-local contexts, caches, closures and symbols; DOM templates are lazy pure factories. Required styles, listeners and timers are installed by invoked owned code. Test-only fixture modules with import-time delegation are excluded. See docs/distribution-initialization-audit.md and the independent optimized consumer evidence.

resolution.typeOnlyRuntimeBehavior: No runtime target; normal ESM import fails ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. Do not emit empty public runtime modules as accidental substitutes.
resolution.matrixExpansion: Validate every subset of types/browser/node/worker/deno/development (64 sets). types wins; otherwise worker selects server before browser, matching stock RC13; otherwise browser selects DOM; otherwise server. Resolver condition-list order cannot override export-object key order.
resolution.requirePolicy: No require branch and no CJS artifact. Modern Node may synchronously require ESM; that does not constitute a supported CommonJS build.
resolution.solidPolicy: No solid branch. A supplied solid condition falls through to ordinary ESM default.

#formatErrorMessage.rule: Resolve to owned Solid utility output, never @base-ui/utils or an unresolved source alias.

rules: Generate exports only from the exact entries and templates; do not publish workspaceOnlyExports, wildcard entries or package.json as an extra entry.
Verify all proposed source and output paths are normalized relative paths with no parent traversal, node_modules, wildcard or encoded traversal.
Workspace source remains private. When publicationName is selected, stage that name with public npm access; do not inherit upstream author/repository identity claims.
Every runtime entry needs both DOM and server artifacts plus independent declarations. Complete-package staging fails on missing paths. Isolated build fixtures cannot claim whole-library completion.
Preserve module boundaries and declarations needed transitively without exposing extra export keys. Exclude tests, proof fixtures, source aliases, caches and absolute local paths.
Optional temporal adapters stay out of root runtime and declaration graphs. Rewrite workspace self-references in staged declarations to the selected publicationName.
Copy LICENSE and NOTICE into the staged package; preserve adapted Base UI and donor source-local notices.

knownIntegrationGaps.evidence: Donor-owned audit must qualify notices for actual adopted files; no adopted-source packing claim at contract stage.
